notes.title: New challenges now available on PlayStation 5!
notes.content:
Hello Shipbreakers! 🤝

New Challenges for PlayStation 5 owners! 🔵

Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 on PlayStation 5 have an exciting new challenge ahead with the arrival of two fantastic DLCs: Steel Giants DLC and the Submarines DLC. 🔥

🔸 Steel Giants DLC - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2STEEL0002

🔸 Submarines DLC - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2SUBMA0001

[previewyoutube=ddUp3ERrhok;full][/previewyoutube]
These DLCs have been released for console owners to enrich the console experience and offer fresh and engaging content that will test your shipbreaking skills like never before on console! 🎮

🔸Steel Giants DLC on PlayStation 5
Steel Giants DLC introduces a new range of massive, heavily-armored ships for you to dismantle. These colossal vessels will push your limits as you work through layers of tough steel plating and complex structures. Every part of these giants presents new opportunities for strategic dismantling and salvage, making this DLC a thrilling challenge on the PlayStation 5 console.

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2STEEL0002

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/24decd802537049a8d684c6323cdad14d5cc71b3.jpg

🔸Submarines DLC on PlayStation 5
Submarines DLC takes you deep below the waves to explore and break down underwater vessels. This DLC features a variety of submarines with unique designs and components that require a different dismantling approach.

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2SUBMA0001

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/3c5ca5eb115ce75d9b02dc9e867f5f595a9dae7d.jpg

Together, these two DLCs bring significant new content and challenges to the PlayStation 5 version of Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. Whether you're conquering the towering Steel Giants or delving into the mysteries of the Submarines, these DLCs promise extra hours in the PlayStation 5! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/c7358393778c5561461219e14c6db5bc9647f447.png

Have fun!
Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Team

notes.title: Deconstruction Simulator is out!- Grab the Bundle
notes.content:
Get ready for deconstruction! 🔥

If you love dismantling ships, well then we think you will love this! Deconstruction Simulator is out on Steam right now- discover a new dimension of dismantling and destruction! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487150/Deconstruction_Simulator/

[previewyoutube=yTmxmp3T3mw;full][/previewyoutube]

Everything we build will be for you to DESTROY! ⚒️

If you want to experience both Ship Graveyard and Deconstruction Simulator we prepared an amazing bundle for you! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59697/Heavy_Duty_Destruction/

In Deconstruction Simulator, you will be able to develop your skills in a completely new environment. Instead of ships, you will dismantle buildings and other structures, which will provide you with new challenges and opportunities for development - discover the joy of dismantling and destruction!

What you can expect right now?
 Over 40 of different contracts and maps, each of them made by hand, unique and beautiful!
 Complete destruction system where you can destroy the whole house right into the fundamentals!
 Improve your company in various ways, from tools, to your own warehouse and vehicles in a satisfying progression loop!
 Freedom - You can be a goody two shoes worker, doing everything by the rules. But nothing stops you from doing what you want. Steal from your clients, take what you want from their houses, if you can accept the consequences.
 And much more!

notes.title: CO-OP PLAYTEST ARE OPEN!
notes.content:
We are very pleased to announce that the CO-OP Mode Playtest has just started and are open to everyone! 💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201940/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator_2/

👇 IMPORTANT 👇
Please remember that these are Playtest of the upcoming version of CO-OP Mode - it is not the final version - therefore, there may be some gameplay issues and bugs. 

If you encounter any bugs or something else, please let us know on Community Hub or our Discord, it will help us to improve the final version of CO-OP - thank you. 


🔶 For players who have signed up earlier - you can start playing the CO-OP Playtest now.

🔶 For players who did not sign up before the start - first click the "request access" button and then you will automatically get access to the Playtest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/cece9ff7091de99b50c645877192263955ede73b.jpg

Playtest of the CO-OP Mode
We decided to Playtest the upcoming CO-OP Mode because we plan to release it for the game in the upcoming 2024 and would like to hear the opinion of our community before we add it to the game. Playtest is something like beta testing, so you can feel like a real QA Tester!

General information
The game will have some restrictions against the full version of the game. Read carefully what you can expect! 
 The server has been limited to 3 players
 Available ships are Maroon Lagoon (connector HP has been reduced) and Caroline
 Players will get more money to start so they can buy both ships plus additional tool upgrades.
 For the duration of the playtests, the following will disappear from the game: - Winche
- Hazard
- Crouching
- Crane upgrades
- Mobile cargo along with input for walkie talkies
- Collectibles 
- Load option
- Continue option
- Credits

Warning:
A new player cannot join the game while a ship is ordered! All players must be present before buying a ship



Suggestions and feedback
We encourage you to send your feedback, suggestions, and bugs you may encounter. We will be very pleased if you leave your opinion about the upcoming CO-OP Mode, it is very important to us to listen to the opinions of our community. You can do this by:

1. Steam Community Hub, where we have created appropriate topics. We also encourage you to create your own.
 📖 CO-OP PLAYTEST | SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK
 🐛 CO-OP PLAYTEST | BUGS & PROBLEMS2. On our dedicated Discord - https://discord.gg/evKuacn8uE


3. Directly in the Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Playtest Steam page


We can't wait to hear your first impressions! 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/25cdf2608fb8ca229fa863444a8fbfb772c1e50f.png

Have fun!
SGS2 Team

notes.title: Update on the release date of Playtest CO-OP Mode
notes.content:
Dear community,

Last week we promised that the Playtest of CO-OP Mode would be available this week, but unfortunately, with great heartache, we have to inform you about the change of the Playtest release date.

Currently, the entire team is involved in bug fixes for Warships DLC, which really surprised us. As a small development team, we want to first improve the stability of the Warships DLC and then fully focus on the Playtest of CO-OP Mode so that you can fully enjoy smashing ships with hammers with your friends, that's why we need a few more days.

Therefore, we decided to change the Playtest release date. We want to be absolutely sure that you - our community - who support our game by purchasing DLC, could enjoy the game without any problems.

Thank you for your understanding - the entire team is working very hard to make sure you can fully experience this next milestone with Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. We assure you that the Playtest version will be ready soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201940/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator_2/


We will get back to you with further information - thank you. 🤝
Ship Graveyard Simulator Team
